import itertools

BIKES = "FGHJ"
RIDERS = "RSTY"

def scenarios():
    """Exhaustively enumerate every valid two-day assignment with Theresa on J on day 1."""
    for d1 in itertools.permutations(BIKES):
        day1 = dict(zip(RIDERS, d1))
        if day1["T"] != "J":
            continue
        for d2 in itertools.permutations(BIKES):
            day2 = dict(zip(RIDERS, d2))
            # Each rider tests a different bicycle on day 2 than on day 1
            if any(day1[r] == day2[r] for r in RIDERS):
                continue
            # Reynaldo cannot test F; Yuki cannot test J (applied to both days)
            if "F" in (day1["R"], day2["R"]):
                continue
            if "J" in (day1["Y"], day2["Y"]):
                continue
            # Theresa must be a tester for H (on either day)
            if "H" not in (day1["T"], day2["T"]):
                continue
            # Seamus tests on day 2 the bicycle Yuki tested on day 1
            if day2["S"] != day1["Y"]:
                continue
            yield day1, day2

valid = list(scenarios())
print("Valid scenarios with Theresa on J on day 1:", len(valid))
for d1, d2 in valid:
    print("Day1:", d1, "Day2:", d2)

options = {
    "A": lambda d1, d2: d2["R"] == "G",
    "B": lambda d1, d2: d1["S"] == "H",
    "C": lambda d1, d2: d2["Y"] == "H",
    "D": lambda d1, d2: "J" in (d1["S"], d2["S"]),
    "E": lambda d1, d2: "G" in (d1["T"], d2["T"]),
}

for name, pred in options.items():
    hits = [(d1, d2) for d1, d2 in valid if pred(d1, d2)]
    status = "CHECK PASS" if hits else "CHECK FAIL"
    print(f"Option {name}: satisfying scenarios = {len(hits)} -> {status}")

submitted = "A"
sub_hits = sum(1 for d1, d2 in valid if options[submitted](d1, d2))
print("Submitted answer:", submitted)
print("Submitted answer could be true:", sub_hits > 0)
print("Submitted answer verdict:", "CHECK PASS" if sub_hits > 0 else "CHECK FAIL")
